text: Re-measure after 5 minutes of seated rest. Avoid caffeine before the next reading. Keep up your planned exercise and fluids.
Repeat the measurement twice, one minute apart. Note any headache, chest discomfort or dizziness. Send the report to the flight surgeon.
Stop strenuous activity. Follow the mission emergency medical procedure and contact the flight surgeon now.
Warm your hands and re-measure with the sensor still for 10 seconds. If it stays at 94% or below, tell the crew medical officer and send the report.
Low blood oxygen together with other warning signs, or a reading below 90%, needs immediate attention. Follow the emergency procedure and contact the flight surgeon now.
Protect your next sleep period: dim lights an hour before, keep the sleep station cool, limit screens. Short sleep is common in flight.
Short sleep, low mood and a raised heart rate together point to strain. Talk to the crew medical officer and request a private conference with the ground.
Check sleep and exercise logs. Keep meals and hydration on the mission plan.
Exercise is the main protection for bone and muscle in microgravity. Return to your planned resistive and aerobic sessions.
Exercise has dropped for several days. Review the schedule with the crew and the ground team.
Fever was measured. Re-measure in 30 minutes, rest, drink fluids, limit close contact with crewmates and send the report.
Fever with other warning signs needs immediate attention. Contact the flight surgeon now.
